system.name: DITTO (Diffusion Inference-Time T-Optimization)
system.one_liner: Controls a pre-trained text-to-music diffusion model at inference time by optimising the initial noise latent through any differentiable feature-matching loss.

content.variant_note: a left-to-right forward chain from noise to loss with a red dashed gradient path laid backwards over it to the noise, and circled numbers 1 to 5 that run back to the starting variable
content.argues: A frozen diffusion model can be steered by optimising only its initial noise: a feature-matching loss is back-propagated through the checkpointed sampling chain to the noise.
content.subject: Initial noise, frozen sampler, spectrogram, feature loss against a target, and the gradient path back to the noise.

lessons.what_to_learn: When the optimised variable is the input and not the model, draw the forward chain in black, lay a red dashed backward path with nabla signs over it, mark frozen parts with padlocks, and show the optimised input as a start dot and an end dot on a contour blob; number the steps so that the order closes back at the input.
lessons.suits: Inference-time optimisation or guidance methods (noise optimisation, prompt tuning, latent search) that back-propagate a loss through a frozen model.

evidence: We propose DITTO, or Diffusion Inference-Time T -Optimization, a general-purpose framework to control pre-trained diffusion
controlling pre-trained text-to-music diffusion models at inference-time via optimizing initial noise latents

summary: DITTO controls a pre-trained text-to-music diffusion model at inference time by optimising its initial noise latent, so no fine-tuning is needed. Figure 1 draws this as one wide chain. A noise x_T ~ N(0, I), shown as a dot in a nested pink blob, and the prompt Upbeat jazz music enter a frozen, checkpointed Diffusion box with an x_{t-1} recurrence; the output x_0 becomes a spectrogram, passes a frozen feature extractor f and meets a Target Feature y (Editing and Control icons) in a Feature Matching Loss. Red dashed arrows marked with nabla run backwards over the chain to the blob, where red arrows lead to the optimised x_T^*. Circled numbers 1 to 5 order the steps.
summary_zh: DITTO 在推理时优化初始噪声来控制预训练的文本到音乐扩散模型。图 1 是一条长链：噪声和提示进入冻结的采样器，得到频谱，经特征提取与目标特征比较算损失，红色虚线 ∇ 箭头反向回到噪声，圆圈数字 1 到 5 标顺序。
notes: The caption in the context file is cut after the first sentence and no paragraph mentions the figure, so roles come from the figure and the abstract only. The meaning of the circled numbers is read from where they sit. The pre-screen listed model-anatomy first; stage-pipeline (closed loop) is primary here because no model internals are drawn, only a frozen black box inside an optimisation loop. The icon-to-task mapping in the Target Feature box is at group level (Editing, Control), not per glyph.
